title: Figs. 4-5: Gemini Experiments D-6 Surface Photography and D-8 Radiation in Spacecraft
description: Two photographs from NASA document M-913-65-04. Fig. 4, captioned "D-6 SURFACE PHOTOGRAPHY," shows a camera mount installed at a Gemini spacecraft window; Fig. 5, captioned "D-8 RADIATION IN SPACECRAFT (PORTABLE UNIT)," shows a spherical ionization chamber with a coiled cable inside the cabin. Accompanying text describes photographing terrestrial objects and measuring radiation dose levels inside the spacecraft.
